note: title_length is machinery only: an abstract service Drupal\title_length\EntityTitleLength (interface EntityTitleLengthInterface, constants ORIGINAL_LENGTH=255, DEFAULT_LENGTH=500) plus a Drush command title_length:update <entity_type>. It has configure=null, no config object, no permissions, no config schema, no plugins. Enabling the parent alone changes nothing; the node_title_length / taxonomy_term_title_length submodules subclass the service and actually widen a title column. getLength() returns Settings::get('<entity_type>_title_length_chars') ?: 500 from settings.php. changeLength() runs Schema::changeField() on the entity data table (and revision data table) title/name column and re-installs the base-field storage definition. The module's real, live-inspectable effect is the width of the DB column (node_field_data.title / taxonomy_term_field_data.name) - the runtime hook_entity_base_field_info_alter always reports getLength(), so introspection/execution cases are grounded in the actual information_schema column width. Medium cases widen a column to a known size and read it back; hard cases shrink a column to 255 then require re-applying via the Drush command.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module title_length raises the maximum length of entity title fields above Drupal's default. If I enable a title_length submodule without setting anything in settings.php, how many characters will titles then allow, and what constant defines that default?
evals.expected_output: By default titles are widened to 500 characters, defined by EntityTitleLengthInterface::DEFAULT_LENGTH (the original core length is 255, EntityTitleLengthInterface::ORIGINAL_LENGTH). EntityTitleLength::getLength() returns Settings::get('<entity_type>_title_length_chars') ?: 500.

evals.prompt: Using the title_length module, I want node titles to allow 1000 characters instead of the default. There is no admin form - where and how do I set the desired length?
evals.expected_output: There is no UI (configure=null). Set $settings['node_title_length_chars'] = 1000; in settings.php (and $settings['taxonomy_term_title_length_chars'] for terms). The variable is <entity_type>_title_length_chars, read by getLength() via Settings::get(); then re-apply with drush title_length:update node.

evals.prompt: I changed the title_length setting in settings.php on a running Drupal site after the module was already installed. Which Drush command re-applies the new length to node titles?
evals.expected_output: Run `drush title_length:update node` (and `drush title_length:update taxonomy_term` for term names). The command resolves the service <entity_type>_title_length.<entity_type>, refuses to shrink below existing data via checkIfExistEntitiesWithLongTitles(), then calls changeLength(getLength()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the node title database column (node_field_data.title) has been widened by the title_length machinery to a specific size. Inspect the live database schema and state the current maximum character length of that column.
evals.expected_output: The node_field_data.title column is varchar(731). It is discoverable from information_schema.COLUMNS (CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH for TABLE_NAME='node_field_data', COLUMN_NAME='title'); note the runtime base-field max_length reported by the entity field manager reflects getLength() (500) and not the actual column, so the schema is the source of truth.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the taxonomy term name database column (taxonomy_term_field_data.name) has been widened by title_length to a specific size. Inspect the live database schema and report the current maximum character length of that column.
evals.expected_output: The taxonomy_term_field_data.name column is varchar(617), readable from information_schema.COLUMNS (CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH for TABLE_NAME='taxonomy_term_field_data', COLUMN_NAME='name').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the node title database column has been shrunk back to the core default of 255 characters, even though the node_title_length module is enabled. Using the title_length module, re-apply the module's default title length (500) to node titles on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush title_length:update node` (or call \Drupal::service('node_title_length.node')->changeLength(500)). This widens node_field_data.title (and node_field_revision.title) back to varchar(500) via Schema::changeField().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the taxonomy term name database column has been shrunk to 255 characters even though taxonomy_term_title_length is enabled. Use the title_length module to re-apply its default length (500) to taxonomy term names on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush title_length:update taxonomy_term` (or call \Drupal::service('taxonomy_term_title_length.taxonomy_term')->changeLength(500)), widening taxonomy_term_field_data.name (and its revision table) back to varchar(500).
